_comment: Anna Executa descriptor for the gamentic engine. The comms layer is app/executa.py (stdio JSON-RPC bridge over the unchanged FastAPI app). anna-app dev discovers this and spawns the command (cwd = this dir).
name: Gamentic
description: Gamentic game engine, exposed as an Anna Executa. One tool, `request`, replays an HTTP-style call against the engine.
